name: Gasthof Weisses Rössl am See
beschreibung: The Gasthof Weisses Rössl am See is located directly on the Thiersee in Tirol. The hotel offers rooms with lake views and some with a balcony. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished. The restaurant serves Tiroler Spezialitäten. Guests can use the terrace with direct lake access. The Thiersee is suitable for swimming in summer. Hiking and cycling trails are nearby.
